title: Standings double-count Athletico Paranaense under two name-spelling variants
evidence: SoccerService.java:22 standings() calls apply(table,m.home(),...) / apply(table,m.away(),...) and apply (line 25) keys the table via computeIfAbsent(team,...) on the RAW team name, never Names.normalize(). _factual.json shows the 2019 Serie A table has 21 rows: 'Athletico Paranaense' (played 27) and 'Atletico Paranaense' (played 11) are the same club split in two (27+11=38), so factual_accuracy=0.0. NOTE: the standings ARE computed from matches (not hardcoded), so R9's how_to_verify bar is met and the capability EXISTS; it is partial, not missing. Also, the first evaluator's proposed fix (use Names.normalize as the key) would NOT merge these rows — normalize lowercases/strips accents but keeps the 'h', so 'athletico'!='atletico'; a real fix needs an alias/fuzzy map.
suggestion: Canonicalize club names to a single alias before keying the standings table (an alias map that folds Athletico<->Atletico Paranaense), not just normalize().
